title: How KrishiMitra Works
subtitle: An intuitive, 5-step journey transforming traditional farming intuition into scientifically validated decisions.

steps.title: Profile & Farm Registration
steps.desc: Farmers register using their mobile number, select their state and district, and enter approximate farm size and soil type without tedious GPS or complex requirements.

steps.title: Soil & Parameter Entry
steps.desc: Enter your Soil Health Card laboratory values (N, P, K, pH) or choose your regional averages. Our soil analyzer immediately grades your soil fertility status.

steps.title: ML Crop Recommendation
steps.desc: Our machine learning pipeline compares your soil chemistry, current season, and rainfall with agronomic thresholds to recommend the most optimal and profitable crop.

steps.title: Dynamic Seasonal Schedule
steps.desc: KrishiMitra creates an automated crop calendar showing exact critical dates for irrigation, fertilizer split-applications, and pest monitoring.

steps.title: Weather Advisories & Mandi Tracking
steps.desc: Receive hyperlocal weather advisories before undertaking field spraying or watering, and monitor live APMC mandi rates to time your harvest sales.
